literal: Harmful things to those who did, pleasant things indeed if not done, what value is nobility of character?
translation: If one does not do pleasant things even to those who have done harm, of what use is one's nobility of character?
modern: நமக்குத் துன்பம் செய்தவர்களுக்கும் நாம் நன்மையே செய்யாவிட்டால், நம்முடைய சான்றாண்மை என்னும் பண்பினால் என்ன பயன்?
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate test of 'சால்பு' (nobility or perfect character). It states that true nobility is not just being good to those who are good to us, but doing good ('இனியவே') even to those who have caused us harm ('இன்னாசெய்தார்'). If a person cannot rise to this level of benevolence, their claim to a noble character holds no real value or purpose.
